injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Barzal isn't expected to need long to recover after he resumes skating. However, it's safe to say he won't play Wednesday in Toronto or Saturday against New Jersey. Barzal is likely to serve on the top line and first power-play unit once he's ready to return.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Knee: The New York Islanders said on Wednesday (Sept. 30) that F Mathew Barzal might resume skating this weekend or early next week, per Andrew Gross of Newsday.

injuries.name: Alexander Romanov
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Romanov was hurt Tuesday (Oct. 6) versus the Rangers and is undergoing further evaluation, Stefen Rosner of NHL.com reports.
